rules.check: The review description states the final purpose of the change.
The review description states the final before-and-after behavior.
The review description explains the final implementation.
The review description identifies every modified extension.

The submitted code satisfies behavioral acceptance criteria explicitly stated in the captured review description. Report only a concrete code defect introduced or worsened by the current delta. Description wording, completeness, chronology, media, and administrative follow-ups are not code defects.
The review description reports measured coverage for affected extensions.
The review description discloses known issues or explicitly states that none are known.
Relevant user-interface changes include current final-state media.

sources.section: Post mockups and progress for review

rules.check: The review description contains no commit chronology, temporary behavior, abandoned approach, or intermediate-only fix.
The review description records the submitted validation evidence.
